implemented.standalone_library: Installable ecg-torch-renderer package with ecg_gpu namespace, MIT license, examples, tests and no Site/trainer dependency
implemented.nn_module: ECGImageLayer [B,12,T] to [B,3,H,W], composable with nn.Sequential, downstream-network backward and image-only rendering
implemented.parameter_distributions: Fixed buffer values plus batched on-device Uniform, Choice, Bernoulli and per-call tensor overrides
implemented.layer_replay: Training call counter and configuration/assets signature in state_dict. Fixed evaluation and optional caller-controlled RNG
implemented.cli: NPY/NPZ and optional WFDB input, lead reorder, mV/uV/V normalization, PNG/JPEG batch export and optional JSON provenance
implemented.batched_device_renderer: Torch printing, masks, deformation, shading and capture on the chosen device
implemented.layouts: 30 standard layouts plus declarative uneven-row/custom/subset arrangements
implemented.rhythm: 0 to 3 independent full-duration strips with per-sample lead selection
implemented.cabrera: Cabrera ordering and inverted aVR with explicit amplitude sign
implemented.physical_scale: isotropic pixels/mm, gain, speed and optional 1mV/0.2s pulses
implemented.signal_raster: bounded subpixel segments and every-source-sample extrema envelope
implemented.paper: 8 color palettes, tint, age, noise, stains, coffee rings, reverse-print bleed and authorized texture banks
implemented.grid: 5 color palettes, continuous/major-only/minor-dot/all-dot styles, optional grid and random phase
implemented.geometry: perspective, quarter rotations, small rotations, zoom, crops, radial distortion, curl and crease
implemented.height_surfaces: flat, curl, fold, accordion, crumpled, wrinkled, rolled and corner
implemented.inverse_relief: Coarse-to-fine Newton solve with two pixel refinements, dense reference, determinant and residual visibility gate
implemented.lights: 3 colored lights, ambient, normal-based diffuse/specular, flash and approximate ambient occlusion
implemented.shadows: height-field ray samples, tabletop contact/cast shadows and soft edge/phone/hand/blinds/window/ellipse families
implemented.tables: wood, marble, laminate, fabric, metal, clinical, plain and leather, plus authorized photo banks
implemented.occlusions: ragged tears, opaque rectangles, pen marks and 4 rotated artifact texts with visibility masks
implemented.text: construction-time font atlas, lead labels, unit headers and user-supplied artifact text/font banks
implemented.thermal_print: ink color/density/width, fade and scan bands
implemented.camera: anisotropic PSF defocus/motion, exposure, WB, vignette, gamma, read/shot noise and quantization
implemented.compression: 4:2:0 chroma, 8x8 DCT and quality-dependent JPEG quantization simulation
implemented.external_documents: inverse UV, visibility, normal, height and shading banks with explicit NPZ schema and hashes
implemented.supervision: geometry, trace, labels, classes, valid, optional 15 instances and visible pixel boxes
implemented.scene_outputs: Optional inverse field, normals, height, metric strain, projection residual, lighting, paper visibility and shadows
implemented.training: Standalone on-the-fly TinyUNet example, downstream CNN/AMP integration and fixed capture replay
implemented.cost_controls: image-only path without dense task masks, surface resolution, Newton iterations, shadow samples, antialiasing, lead chunks and selected targets
implemented.advanced_supervision: ECGSupervisionLayer: selected lead channels, union/BW/WB, visible/projected and soft/binary targets, lead/instance boxes, CLI NPZ/JSON/PNG export
implemented.documentation: English static guide, local search, generated API reference and 125 actual renderer figures
implemented.material_paper: Unit-tangent integrated bends, signed finite creases, local shortening approximation and observable metric error
implemented.scene_compilation: Optional deterministic material, illumination and Newton kernels, generator draws remain eager
implemented.kernel_profiling: Kernel-category Chrome events only, annotations and memory transfers excluded

approximations.gradient: Rendering is preprocessing without gradients to the source ECG. The downstream image network remains trainable
approximations.cli_encoding: File reading, font initialization and PNG/JPEG/JSON encoding happen on CPU outside the training hot path
approximations.procedural_geometry: Developable 2.5D bends with approximate local crease shortening, not a general shell dynamics/self-intersection solver
approximations.paper_overlap: supported when supplied external inverse maps already encode 3D visibility, not generated by the procedural height model
approximations.lighting: local shading and approximate shadows, not spectral path tracing or a complete camera pipeline
approximations.jpeg: decoded-artifact simulation, not an entropy-coded JPEG bitstream
approximations.handwriting: scribbles by default and rotated text. Actual handwriting glyphs need supplied TTF/OTF fonts
approximations.visibility: geometric support/opaque occlusion. Unit classification does not verify OCR readability
approximations.boxes: visible raster occupancy, not full invisible/truncated waveform extent
approximations.tables: procedural defaults. Photographic banks are accepted but not included
